Subject: Tenant kickoff: initial access + SOC2 items

Hi Jonas / Monica,

Thanks for the quick intro — we’re excited to get OncoTech’s sandbox wired into Redwood. A couple of asks from our side to make the kickoff productive:

- Can you share a suggested timeline for API key seeding and initial project creation? We want to have engineers start smoke tests next week.
- We attached our security questionnaire and would like to confirm what artifacts you’ll provide (SOC 2 report / auth flow doc).
- Who will be the Redwood contact to seed service accounts and invite our dev/admin users?

Proposed attendees for a 30-minute kickoff: me (Emma), Chris (platform eng), and two of your CS/impl leads.

Attachments: OncoTech-Security-Questions.pdf

Thanks,
Emma Cole
Head of Platform, OncoTech
emma@oncotech.com

-----Original Message-----

Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant kickoff: initial access + SOC2 items

Emma — thanks for the details and the questionnaire. Quick reply with a clear plan so you can share with your team before the kickoff: 

1) Timeline (target):
   - Day 0 (kickoff call): confirm list of dev/admin users and roles, share onboarding one-pager.
   - Day 1: Redwood creates a tenant (project namespace), seeds two API keys (admin + read-only smoke key), and delivers a service-account JSON for CI.
   - Day 2: Your engineers run smoke tests; we monitor token-level requests and resolve any mapping issues.

2) What we’ll provide now:
   - SOC 2 cover sheet and contact for audit requests (I’ve attached a short checklist we use for seeding keys).
   - A short doc on token scopes and best-practice service accounts.

3) What we need from you:
   - Final list of users (email + role: admin/dev/read-only).
   - Confirmation of preferred region (us/eu/apac) — default to us if not specified.

Can we run kickoff tomorrow at 11:00 PT? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and a live doc link ahead of time.

Attachments: APIs-and-Keys-checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Implementation Lead, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
